title: BAI Advanced Coaches Course Underway in Guwahati & Raipur
indian_angle: This program is crucial for developing the next generation of Indian badminton coaches and improving coaching standards nationwide.
summary: The Badminton Association of India's Level-1 Advanced Coaches Course is currently running at National Centers of Excellence in Guwahati and Raipur, from September 14th to 23rd.

title: New Regulations Issued for Inter State Team Championships 2026
indian_angle: These regulations will govern a major domestic event, shaping the competitive landscape for Indian state teams.
